answer.title: What you can buy
answer.body_html: Under AED 5M, Dubai buyers can usually compare premium apartments, larger 2-bedroom layouts, selected 3-bedroom units, townhouses in family communities, and some villas outside ultra-prime zones. The realistic choice depends on district, developer, size, payment plan, handover and hidden costs.

tradeoffs.title: Tradeoffs
tradeoffs.body: A budget page should help the buyer understand market reality. Under AED 5M, the best option is not always the largest unit or the most famous district. Primadom AI should compare district maturity, developer, size, floor plan, payment plan, service charges, handover and resale liquidity before recommending a shortlist.

items.question: What can I buy in Dubai under AED 5M?
items.answer: Under AED 5M, buyers can usually compare premium apartments, selected 3-bedroom units, townhouses in family communities and some villas depending on district, developer and availability.

items.question: Which districts are relevant under AED 5M?
items.answer: Relevant districts can include Dubai Hills Estate, Business Bay, Dubai Creek Harbour, JVC, Arjan, Meydan, Town Square, Arabian Ranches and Damac Hills depending on property type.

items.question: What hidden costs should I check?
items.answer: Check DLD fees, agency fees, service charges, maintenance, furnishing, mortgage costs, payment plan exposure and possible post-handover obligations.

items.question: Can Primadom AI check my budget?
items.answer: Yes. Primadom AI can compare budget, down payment, payment plan, district, property type and buyer goal to prepare a shortlist.
